title_zh: DiMo-GUI：基于模态感知视觉推理的 GUI 定位测试时扩展
one_line: Training-free grounding: separate text/icon passes, each zooming iteratively around the prior prediction; evidence is ScreenSpot-Pro/ScreenSpot accuracy only.
one_line_zh: 免训练定位：文本与图标分开处理，各自围绕上一次预测逐步放大；证据仅为ScreenSpot-Pro与ScreenSpot定位准确率。

online_eval.quote: we conduct extensive experiments on two GUI grounding benchmarks: ScreenSpot Cheng et al. (2024) and ScreenSpot-Pro Li et al. (2025) .

evidence_level.quote: We evaluate the effectiveness of the DiMo-GUI framework on the latest ScreenSpot-Pro dataset.

S1.quote: It nearly doubles the performance metrics of OS-ATLAS-7B and UGroundV1-7B on the ScreenSpot-Pro benchmark, with substantial improvements observed across all subsets.

title_zh: 少即是多：基于上下文感知简化增强 GUI 智能体

title_zh: R-VLM：面向精确 GUI 定位的区域感知视觉语言模型
one_line: Two-stage zoom-in grounding around the first predicted box plus IoU-weighted loss on SeeClick's data; ScreenSpot/GroundUI gains and offline AITW/Mind2Web.
one_line_zh: 以首次预测框为区域提议放大再定位，并用IoU加权交叉熵训练；ScreenSpot/GroundUI提升，AITW/Mind2Web为离线评测。

title_zh: MobileGUI-RL：在线环境强化学习提升移动端 GUI 智能体
one_line: Online trajectory GRPO in Android emulators with VLM-judged rewards, self-explored tasks filtered by a text world model; AndroidWorld 7B 22->30, 32B 31.5->44.8.
one_line_zh: 在安卓模拟器中做轨迹级在线GRPO，奖励由VLM判定，任务经自探索生成并由文本世界模型过滤；AndroidWorld 7B 22→30，32B 31.5→44.8。

online_eval.quote: We evaluate on three online GUI agent benchmarks that require agents to complete a variety of tasks within interactive environments.

strong_baselines.quote: Our smaller model, MobileGUI-7B , demonstrates significant gains over its base model, Qwen2.5-VL-7B.

cost_reported.quote: We train our agent for one epoch on a dataset of 436 curated GUI navigation tasks. For each task, we collect eight rollouts using 7B models and four rollouts using 32B models, with a maximum episode length of 25 steps.

component_ablation.quote: MobileGUI-RL (Full Model) 30.0 44.8 w/o Task Filtering 28.5 41.0 w/o Curriculum Learning 25.0 34.0 w/o Decaying Reward 23.5 35.5

evidence_level.quote: The Success Rate (SR) on AndroidWorld (AW) improves from 22.0% to 30.0%, and most notably, we see a remarkable jump on Android-in-the-Wild General (AITW-Gen) tasks from 49.0% to 65.3%.
